_comment: Reviewed exemptions for scripts/quality/validate-corpus.py. Each entry means: a human decided
this corpus model is deliberately allowed to not parse against the current schema, and here is
why. The key is the model's corpus label (e.g. 'AppGen/apps/_official/AuxScreen' or
'NPDevSamples/canonical-demo'), so renaming or moving the app invalidates the exemption and it
resurfaces for re-review -- which is the point.
Empty today: docs/CORPUS_INTEGRITY_PLAN.md's C2 migrates every currently-broken model rather than
excepting any of them (they are the DSL's only volume regression corpus). Add an entry here only
for a genuine, reviewed exception with a REG id -- never pre-clear speculatively.
